sources.title: SDNQ Quantization | InvokeAI Documentation
sources.snippet: SDNQ (SD.Next Quantization Engine) is a quantization scheme that stores model weights at 4-5 bits with an optional low-rank SVD correction. InvokeAI loads SDNQ-quantized models as full HuggingFace diffusers pipelines and dequantizes weights on the fly during inference, with no extra Python package required.
